NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author squashed the fixup commits (4 down to 2) and replied that a screenshot isn't needed because the change has no visible UI difference. They offered a screen recording instead, and no new screenshots were added.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌  | Before/after screenshots still don't meet the precise-screenshot guidelines. The change does affect how code blocks render and copy, so the author's "no visible difference" argument doesn't hold. |
| ⚠️  | Commits were squashed, but the two subjects ("fix for issue 17419", "added test case for issue 17418") still lack the `area: Imperative.` format. The test is also a separate commit from the fix, and the second subject names the wrong issue number. |
| ℹ️  | The issue is also claimed by jlnsmith2001, who is working on it as part of a CodeDay internship with two others. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask for properly formatted commits and precise before/after screenshots.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for squashing the commits! The commit titles still need to follow our [commit discipline](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html) (e.g. "markdown: Preserve tabs in fenced code blocks."), and the test should go in the same commit as the fix. This change does affect how code blocks render, so please add before/after screenshots following [this guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
